item.title: WATCH: Eviction standoff turns war zone as gunman kills deputy in ambush, gets run over by armored vehicle
item.summary: Deputy Randy Hoppert was killed in a Porterville, California, standoff after a suspect opened fire as deputies served an eviction notice.

item.summary: Savannah, Athens and Atlanta face mounting homelessness and public disorder concerns as Georgia lawmakers push a bill to force cities to enforce laws.
